name: Lew Spectre
caption: Won the NCCW Television Title on the fed's own titles page, defended it in the main event of the fed's own Battle in Seattle pay-per-view, and held it for over eighteen months without ever losing it before forfeiting the belt when the promotion folded and closing out the fed's run in a heated feud with World Champion "Dominator" Don Cameron. He then took "Strictly Business" to GPW, where he lost a World Heavyweight Title match to Eugene Robinson at Turkey Time Terror in November 1999, to Classic Championship Wrestling's 2001 return, to WWO, and to OSW Online, where he wrestled into February 2003.

tenures.role: wrestler — held the NCCW Television Title for over eighteen months, forfeiting it undefeated when the promotion folded; also billed as fending off an invading NWWF promotion during his run, and closed the fed's own final stretch in a feud with World Champion "Dominator" Don Cameron
tenures.source: Not named in NCCW's own single surviving self-authored document (the Dec 1998 recruitment/FAQ ad). Reconstructed entirely from third-party corroboration, per the canonical-copy rule (none of it is reproduced as this wing's own page): his own later career retrospective, self-authored for a different federation (OSW Online's own 2002 bio card — "in 1998, the promise of 'Classic' wrestling lured Lew back to join the NCCW, a promotion in which he was a centerpiece of. Among his many highlights, Lew held the NCCW TV title for over 18 months, never actually losing the title but forfieting it as the promotion folded. Lew also fended off an invading NWWF promotion..."); the RSPWF Top 200's own year-end poll, which tagged him NCCW twice (1999: #168, already served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/top-200-1999.html; 2000: #156, already served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/top-200-2000.html); and a fellow participant's own 2003 Usenet reminiscence naming a feud with NCCW World Champion "Dominator" Don Cameron (served as an excerpt, promotions/nccw-1998/archive/nccw-usenet-2003-08-04-reminiscence-excerpt.html).

The fed's own served bio card (promotions/osw-online/archive/osw-online-bio-spectre-2019-08-07.html) and the fed's own served results/video-library pages, which bill him in the main event of three of its first four cards. His 2002 run is staged on the fed's own cards and flash shows posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy, 17 shows from its Kickoff, 22 January 2002 (his opening promo) to its Flashback, 8 December 2002: Kickoff, 22 January 2002; Flashback, 26 January 2002; Interactive, 30 January 2002; Insession, 5 February 2002; Flashback, 9 February 2002; Interactive, 13 February 2002; Insession, 26 February 2002; Insession, 19 March 2002; Flashback, 8 April 2002; Insession, 23 April 2002; Insession, 11 June 2002; House Show, 14 July 2002; Interactive, 18 August 2002; Flashback, 25 August 2002; Field Trip, 3 September 2002; Interactive, 24 November 2002; Flashback, 8 December 2002.
